hero.title:
Deaf and
Blinded God
hero.description: Nine songs born from darkness, extinction, and the possibility of evolving.

album.title:
An open wound
in the cosmos.
album.body: A parasite invades its host until it consumes it. This is how Ominosa sees humanity: a brief and destructive species upon a floating rock. Deaf and Blinded God travels through panspermia, power, war and self-destruction—yet leaves room to choose something beyond hate.

items.name: From Skies Above
items.text: A vision of humanity as a host: invasive, devastating and fleeting against the cosmic scale.

items.name: Tyrant's Fall
items.text: Limitless ambition and absolute power; the weight of their consequences always falls on others.

items.name: Faces of Oblivion
items.text: The same mistake in an endless loop: wars, expansion and innocent lives erased in its wake.

story.title:
Sound born
in Costa Rica.
story.body: Ominosa is a Costa Rican melodic death metal band. Through crushing riffs, dense atmospheres and a conceptual gaze, the band builds songs where human violence and introspection collide head-on.
story.production: Deaf and Blinded God was crafted at VM Studio with Carlos Vega Madrigal and GBHrekordz. Gilberth of Sr. Mephisto took part in the drum recording; the introductions and orchestral elements were created by Gabo Montero.
